about.title: About Me
about.description: I’ve worked at Tirasa for around three years, developing and customising identity and access management solutions with Java, Spring Boot, Apache Syncope and Apereo CAS. I adapt them to clients’ needs. I’m also an Apache Syncope Committer and contribute to the project’s development. Backend development is where I have the most experience, but frontend is what I enjoy most. Programming is also part of my free time: I like working on personal projects and trying technologies I use less often at work. This portfolio, built with React and TypeScript, is one of the projects through which I pursue that interest. Alongside programming, I enjoy being outdoors and spending time in nature. I’ve been a Scout since I was little, so Scouting has been part of my life since childhood. Sport has also had its place: I played basketball for many years, and it’s a part of my background I like to share alongside my work and other interests.
